SYNTHETIC FIXTURES (T7). Real Quizlet set pages refuse plain automated reads, so these
files were written by hand in the shape of the reader script's output
(lib/core/services/quizlet_page_script.dart) and of Quizlet's embedded data as understood
at design time. They are NOT captured from real pages.
T17 (device pass) must run the script on real sets - the owner's example set
https://quizlet.com/ar/987534268/job-interview-flash-cards/ and two others of different
sizes, plus a robot-check page - save the output here and confirm or fix the script
selectors and the parser against them.
